shortDescription: Snap meals, track protein, evolve your dragon. AI-powered daily protein goals.
fullDescription:
ProteinQuest turns hitting your protein goal into a daily game you actually want to play.

Snap any meal with your camera. AI estimates the protein in seconds — no manual logging, no barcode hunting, no guesswork. Set your personalized daily target once, then build the habit one scan at a time.

HOW IT WORKS
• Scan meals with your camera or photo library
• Get instant AI protein estimates for each dish
• Track your progress toward one clear daily goal
• Review your food log and trends over time

YOUR DAILY DRAGON
Every morning, pick Ember, Frost, or Moss — your dragon for the day. Hit your protein goal to earn XP and evolve through five forms. Streaks, levels, and unlocks keep you coming back without feeling like a chore.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Whether you're bulking, cutting, or just trying to eat enough protein, ProteinQuest focuses on the one number that matters most. Clean dark UI, fast scans, and honest estimates — designed for gym-goers, meal preppers, and anyone tired of complicated trackers.

FEATURES
• AI meal scanning from camera or gallery
• Personalized protein goal based on your stats
• Daily food log with protein and calorie estimates
• Trends view to see consistency over time
• Dragon companion with XP, levels, and evolution
• Anonymous sign-in — start tracking in seconds

ProteinQuest provides nutritional estimates for informational purposes only. It is not medical advice. Always consult a qualified professional for dietary or health decisions.

Download ProteinQuest and make your daily protein target the easiest win of your day.
